notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
